title: Handle both RESOURCE_TABLE and FIELD_VALUES in ResourceSearchResponse consumers
answers: Why does the shared-dashboard folder check fail against an older Grafana server?
How to check if a search response contains a given field when the result format may vary?
What breaks if I assume search responses always use FIELD_VALUES format?
body:
Symptom: folder-field presence check for shared-dashboard permission lookups could silently misbehave if the search backend server is on an older version.
Root cause: a client may request FIELD_VALUES but an older server still responds with RESOURCE_TABLE; field presence must be checked against whichever format was actually returned.
Fix pattern: pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go:searchResponseHasField branches on `response.GetResultFormat()`, checking `response.GetFields()` for FIELD_VALUES or `response.GetResults().GetColumns()` for RESOURCE_TABLE.
Constraints: any new code that inspects a ResourceSearchResponse for a specific field's presence (not just by index) must go through this kind of format-aware check rather than assuming the requested ResultFormat was honored, to stay compatible with mixed-version deployments.
applies: Code in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard reading ResourceSearchResponse from the unified storage search client
says: Shared dashboard permission check fails against older Grafana servers
Dashboard search breaks when querying against previous versions
Folder field detection in search responses fails inconsistently
Search response format compatibility issue prevents dashboard sharing
search: ResourceSearchResponse consumers must branch on response.GetResultFormat() and check the corresponding field location because a client requesting FIELD_VALUES may receive RESOURCE_TABLE from an older server in mixed-version deployments. Field-presence checks must inspect response.GetFields() for FIELD_VALUES or response.GetResults().GetColumns() for RESOURCE_TABLE format rather than assuming the requested format was honored. This pattern is implemented in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go:searchResponseHasField and must be applied to any new code reading ResourceSearchResponse from the unified storage search client to maintain backward compatibility.
